stem: $ABCD$ is a cyclic quadrilateral, and $B$ and $C$ lie on the same side of $AD$. Given that $m(\angle ABD) = ({=p}x + {=q})^\circ$ and $m(\angle ACD) = ({=r}x + {=s})^\circ$, find the value of $x$.
solution: $ABCD$ is cyclic, so the angles $\angle ABD$ and $\angle ACD$ drawn on the same base $AD$ and on the same side of it are equal.
